title: Fix error recovery for name-only container queries
author: daeshawnballard
summary: With errorRecovery, `@container name { }` (valid name-only query) emits a false `EndOfInput` warning and an extra space, because the condition is parsed first and its error recovery kicks in. The PR checks for name + exhausted prelude before parsing a condition. Small, targeted, with Rust and JS tests; PR is still marked draft.
evidence: Master CLI /home/user/lightningcss/target/review/ref-574eee2/lightningcss (master 574eee2): `--minify --error-recovery` on `@container scroll-content { .foo { max-width: 100cqw; } }` prints `Unexpected end of input at a.css:0:27` and outputs `@container scroll-content  {.foo{max-width:100cqw}}` (double space). Only PR for #1370. No maintainer comments. Diff is a 6-line reorder in parser.rs `container` prelude. Note: the PR is a draft; check `@container name /* comment */ {` and nested cases (tests cover them).
